{{Quote|The Coronas are vicious. Their leader, Kovic, is known as the "Shadow of Corellia." Likes to make CorSec officers disappear from broad daylight. He knows Corellia as well as any CorSec officer and twice as well as our men. If the Republic wants to take the Black Hole, they'll need to take him down first.|Carhart|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Kovic''', known as the '''Shadow of Corellia''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] who led the [[Coronas]] gang operating in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Corellia]], he and his boss, the corrupt politician [[Harmon Torvix]], took control of the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery, and [[Battle for the Black Hole|fought]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] for control of the region. Kovic was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle with Republic forces atop the [[HyperMatter Tower]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kovic appears as the final boss of the Republic Heroic mission "Chasing the Shadow," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
